real_objective: Implement fair-battery part 2 as prefix-only fitted baseline members and repair the S3a vacuous leak scan by materializing every frozen member-view record in memory before scanning.
claim_ceiling: Instrument code plus sealing/leak instrumentation evidence only; no gap, baseline-power, environment-validity, learning, mechanism, agency, or EGO claim.

candidates.name: minimal_manifest_only
candidates.implementation_shape: Declare the seven S3b members and write reports without fitting real lookup tables.
candidates.evidence_it_would_produce: Fresh JSON artifacts and import-graph tests only.
candidates.strongest_cheap_baseline_that_could_matc: A static reporter or stub predictor could match all outputs.
candidates.leakage_or_hardcoding_risk: High: would collapse into report self-consistency and violate real fitted table requirement.
candidates.smallest_falsifying_test: Fit on a tiny prefix stream with action-specific outcomes; prediction remains uniform or unchanged.
candidates.expected_failure_mode: Pass-shaped artifacts with no discriminative baseline implementation.

candidates.name: full_frozen_log_fit_all_partitions
candidates.implementation_shape: Fit graph-cache and retrieval members on all frozen records, including heldout partition records.
candidates.evidence_it_would_produce: Strong apparent table coverage and low fallback usage.
candidates.strongest_cheap_baseline_that_could_matc: Heldout memorization or lookup parity could match the tested members.
candidates.leakage_or_hardcoding_risk: Medium to high: member-view records omit hidden latents, but fitting on heldout records would contaminate train/heldout coverage reporting.
candidates.smallest_falsifying_test: Manifest/reports show heldout records included in the fitting partition.
candidates.expected_failure_mode: Baseline overpowered by access-regime contamination rather than legitimate prefix-only fitting.

candidates.name: train_partition_prefix_only_fit
candidates.implementation_shape: Fit seven S3b members from regenerated train-partition member-view streams only; compute heldout key coverage separately without adding heldout records to member state; materialized leak scan streams all train+heldout member-view records through the key/type scanner.
candidates.evidence_it_would_produce: Callable predictor behavior, alias reports with train/heldout coverage, fitting contract, per-set leak-scan counts and sha checks.
candidates.strongest_cheap_baseline_that_could_matc: Simple action-count or last-symbol tables can still match some behavior, which is allowed because this slice implements fair challengers rather than scoring gaps.
candidates.leakage_or_hardcoding_risk: Low if key construction records only action, observation symbol, session index, turn index, and session boundary; heldout coverage is measured but not fitted.
candidates.smallest_falsifying_test: A predictor changes after future records, uses hidden keys, imports simulator internals, or reports an alias key absent from its fitted table.
candidates.expected_failure_mode: Legitimate baseline remains weak under later S3d scoring, but the instrument remains honest.

selection_reason: It is the smallest approach that satisfies real fitted members, prefix-only access, train/heldout separation, alias reporting, and the mandatory leak-scan repair without adding a second simulator or evidence path.

frozen_metric_baseline_ablation_contract.metrics: None in S3b; no gap scoring or headroom numbers are authorized.
frozen_metric_baseline_ablation_contract.baselines: successor_map, transition_table, count_table, fsm_planner, episodic_traversal, rag_k5_episode_retrieval, nearest_neighbor_user_matching only.
frozen_metric_baseline_ablation_contract.ablation: None in S3b; should-win certificates are deferred to S3d by the task slice.

stop_conditions: Missing frozen fitting-access fields needed to declare the regime, sets, or partition.
Member-view sha256 regeneration mismatch for any frozen set.
New battery module imports simulator internals or reaches hidden simulator fields.
Any new artifact uses static verdicts, hand-written scores, or heldout records as fitting data.
rollback_plan: Delete only the new S3b files and artifacts created by this slice; do not modify S3a artifacts or frozen governance files.
